hypotheses.capacity_notes: Capacity is the minimum of the two venues' capacity, further reduced by the capital that must sit idle in transit.
hypotheses.cost_treatment: conservative_cost_stack(venue, cross_venue=True) on both legs; 1x/2x/3x reported
falsifiers: net marked-equity return <= 0 over the campaign
a majority of walk-forward windows negative
any liquidation or maintenance-margin breach along the path
either venue panel is missing or fails validation
hypotheses.periodicity: 1h bars aligned across venues; settled funding per venue
hypotheses.signal: Trailing mean of the settled funding SPREAD (bybit minus okx), held between settlements. Enter when |spread| exceeds entry_threshold.
hypotheses.thesis: When settled funding on the two venues diverges, long the lower-funding perpetual and short the higher-funding perpetual, collecting the spread. Requires both venue panels; must beat max(H1, H2, cash) after the complete cost of operating on two venues, including capital transfer and the unhedged window.
hypotheses.title: Bybit/OKX BTC funding dispersion, full venue-switching cost
